Item 1. Business

We are a full-stack accelerated computing company. Our data center platform combines processors, interconnects, systems and software. Demand for accelerated computing grew as customers built large AI models.

Our business has two operating segments, Compute and Networking, and Graphics. Customers include cloud service providers, consumer internet companies and enterprises.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our operations could be affected by the complex and changing geopolitical environment. Export controls may restrict our ability to sell certain products to customers in some regions.

We depend on third parties to manufacture, assemble, package and test our products. A significant disruption at our foundry partners in Taiwan could materially affect our supply.

Competition in accelerated computing is intense, and customers may design their own chips.

See Item 7 for a discussion of our liquidity.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue for fiscal year 2026 increased driven by data center compute and networking. Gross margin improved due to product mix.
